column1: # analysis/naming/ram_g4.tsv -- RAM name proposals of naming pass g4 (banks 2D 2E 2F 48), config/ram format: addr name size type status evidence

# NOT loaded by the generator; the orchestrator reconciles against config/ram.  D400-D52F/D724/D726-D728/D824 rows are WRAM BANK 1 only (SVBK=1): the same CPU addresses hold unrelated data in other WRAM banks. SRAM rows name the bank in the evidence (SRAM banks overlap at A000-BFFF).

# Names shared with other passes (wTextCellsLeft C2EE, wTimerASeconds C2D5, wTimerAMinutes C2D6) are deliberately not repeated here; see ram_g1/ram_g2.  The bank-1 SRAM bytes A684-A693 (sHelpProgress) and the tutorial counters A881/A89A/A89B (sTutorialStepBrowser/Mail/Top) are named by ram_g7 (same meaning as found here); the checksum-3 spans are A684-A693 + A87D-A8B4.
# SRAM extents are valid inside the named bank only (banks overlap at A000-BFFF), so apparent overlaps with rows of other SRAM banks are expected.
